title: Embedding commutes with applying an action
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer, let $Q$ be a state set, let $\Sigma$ be a symbol alphabet, and let $x$ be an input word over $\Sigma$. For every one-step action $a$ on $k$ work tapes and configuration $c$ with state set $Q$ and input $x$, applying the action after renaming its successor states by the left inclusion $Q\to Q\sqcup\{0,1,2\}$ and extending it by an inert work tape to the embedded configuration of $c$ gives the embedding of the configuration obtained by applying $a$ to $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is an action on $k$ work tapes over $\Sigma$ and $Q$
$c$ is a configuration with $k$ work tapes, state set $Q$, and input $x$
replaced:
Let $a$ be a one-step action of a machine with $k$ work tapes and state set
$Q$, and let $c$ be a configuration of such a machine.  Rename the states of
$a$ along the left inclusion $Q \to Q \sqcup \{0,1,2\}$ and extend the result
by an inert $(k+1)$-st tape.  Applying this extended, renamed action to the
embedding of $c$ into the $(k+1)$-tape oracle model yields exactly the
embedding of the configuration obtained by applying $a$ to $c$.
